requirements_results.requirement_title: Autenticación de usuarios y control de sesiones
requirements_results.raw_response:
{
  "test_cases": [
    {
      "id": "TC-01",
      "title": "Successful login with valid credentials and redirection to dashboard",
      "level": "smoke",
      "preconditions": "User is registered with valid email and password. The system is running and accessible.",
      "steps": [
        "User navigates to the login page.",
        "User enters a valid email address and correct password.",
        "User clicks the 'Login' button."
      ],
      "expected": "The user is redirected to the dashboard page with a valid session token in the response headers.",
      "covers": ["AC-01"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-02",
      "title": "Login fails after 5 consecutive incorrect password attempts",
      "level": "negative",
      "preconditions": "User is registered with a valid email but has no password set. The system allows up to 5 failed login attempts.",
      "steps": [
        "User navigates to the login page.",
        "User enters a valid email and an incorrect password.",
        "User repeats this step five times consecutively.",
        "User attempts to log in a sixth time with the same email and password."
      ],
      "expected": "The account is temporarily blocked, and a message is displayed indicating that the account is locked due to too many failed attempts.",
      "covers": ["AC-02"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-03",
      "title": "Password reset link expires after 15 minutes",
      "level": "functional",
      "preconditions": "User is registered with a valid email. The password reset feature is enabled.",
      "steps": [
        "User navigates to the login page and clicks 'Forgot Password'.",
        "User enters a valid email and submits the request.",
        "The system generates a password reset link and sends it via email.",
        "User checks the email after 15 minutes to verify the link status."
      ],
      "expected": "The password reset link is no longer valid or accessible after 15 minutes, and the user receives a message indicating the link has expired.",
      "covers": ["AC-03"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-04",
      "title": "Session remains active after browser close and reopen with 'Remember me' enabled",
      "level": "edge",
      "preconditions": "User is registered and has enabled the 'Remember me' option during login. The session token is stored securely.",
      "steps": [
        "User logs in with valid credentials and selects 'Remember me'.",
        "User closes the browser completely.",
        "User opens the browser again and navigates to the login page.",
        "User attempts to access the dashboard without re-entering credentials."
      ],
      "expected": "The user is automatically logged in and redirected to the dashboard without needing to re-enter credentials.",
      "covers": ["AC-04"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-05",
      "title": "Login fails with invalid email format",
      "level": "negative",
      "preconditions": "User is registered with a valid email. The system validates email format on login.",
      "steps": [
        "User navigates to the login page.",
        "User enters an invalid email (e.g., 'invalid-email') and a valid password.",
        "User clicks the 'Login' button."
      ],
      "expected": "The system displays an error message indicating an invalid email format, and no session is created.",
      "covers": ["AC-01"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-06",
      "title": "Login fails with empty password field",
      "level": "negative",
      "preconditions": "User is registered with a valid email. The system requires a password field to be filled.",
      "steps": [
        "User navigates to the login page.",
        "User enters a valid email and leaves the password field empty.",
        "User clicks the 'Login' button."
      ],
      "expected": "The system displays an error message indicating that the password field is required, and no session is created.",
      "covers": ["AC-01"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-07",
      "title": "Session token expires after 30 minutes of inactivity",
      "level": "edge",
      "preconditions": "User is logged in successfully. The session timeout is set to 30 minutes.",
      "steps": [
        "User logs in successfully and is redirected to the dashboard.",
        "User performs no actions for 30 minutes.",
        "User attempts to access the dashboard after 30 minutes of inactivity."
      ],
      "expected": "The user is redirected to the login page, and a message indicates that the session has expired.",
      "covers": ["AC-01"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-08",
      "title": "User attempts to log in with expired password reset link",
      "level": "negative",
      "preconditions": "User is registered. A password reset link has been sent and expired after 15 minutes.",
      "steps": [
        "User navigates to the password reset page.",
        "User enters the email used to generate the expired link.",
        "User clicks on the expired link in the email."
      ],
      "expected": "The system displays a message indicating that the password reset link has expired and a new one must be requested.",
      "covers": ["AC-03"]
    }
  ]
}

test_cases.title: Successful login with valid credentials and redirection to dashboard
test_cases.preconditions: User is registered with valid email and password. The system is running and accessible.
steps: User navigates to the login page.
User enters a valid email address and correct password.
User clicks the 'Login' button.
test_cases.expected: The user is redirected to the dashboard page with a valid session token in the response headers.

test_cases.title: Login fails after 5 consecutive incorrect password attempts
test_cases.preconditions: User is registered with a valid email but has no password set. The system allows up to 5 failed login attempts.
steps: User navigates to the login page.
User enters a valid email and an incorrect password.
User repeats this step five times consecutively.
User attempts to log in a sixth time with the same email and password.
test_cases.expected: The account is temporarily blocked, and a message is displayed indicating that the account is locked due to too many failed attempts.

test_cases.title: Password reset link expires after 15 minutes
test_cases.preconditions: User is registered with a valid email. The password reset feature is enabled.
steps: User navigates to the login page and clicks 'Forgot Password'.
User enters a valid email and submits the request.
The system generates a password reset link and sends it via email.
User checks the email after 15 minutes to verify the link status.
test_cases.expected: The password reset link is no longer valid or accessible after 15 minutes, and the user receives a message indicating the link has expired.

test_cases.title: Session remains active after browser close and reopen with 'Remember me' enabled
test_cases.preconditions: User is registered and has enabled the 'Remember me' option during login. The session token is stored securely.
steps: User logs in with valid credentials and selects 'Remember me'.
User closes the browser completely.
User opens the browser again and navigates to the login page.
User attempts to access the dashboard without re-entering credentials.
test_cases.expected: The user is automatically logged in and redirected to the dashboard without needing to re-enter credentials.

test_cases.title: Login fails with invalid email format
test_cases.preconditions: User is registered with a valid email. The system validates email format on login.
steps: User navigates to the login page.
User enters an invalid email (e.g., 'invalid-email') and a valid password.
User clicks the 'Login' button.
test_cases.expected: The system displays an error message indicating an invalid email format, and no session is created.

test_cases.title: Login fails with empty password field
test_cases.preconditions: User is registered with a valid email. The system requires a password field to be filled.
steps: User navigates to the login page.
User enters a valid email and leaves the password field empty.
User clicks the 'Login' button.
test_cases.expected: The system displays an error message indicating that the password field is required, and no session is created.

test_cases.title: Session token expires after 30 minutes of inactivity
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in successfully. The session timeout is set to 30 minutes.
steps: User logs in successfully and is redirected to the dashboard.
User performs no actions for 30 minutes.

requirements_results.requirement_title: Búsqueda y filtrado de productos en catálogo
requirements_results.raw_response:
{
  "test_cases": [
    {
      "id": "TC-01",
      "title": "Search for product by keyword matching name or description",
      "level": "smoke",
      "preconditions": "User is on the product catalog page with a functional search bar and category filters.",
      "steps": [
        "Enter 'laptop' in the search bar and press enter.",
        "Verify the list of products displayed includes items with 'laptop' in name or description."
      ],
      "expected": "Products matching 'laptop' in name or description are shown in the catalog.",
      "covers": ["AC-01"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-02",
      "title": "Filter products by category to show only items in that category",
      "level": "functional",
      "preconditions": "User is on the product catalog page with a functional category filter.",
      "steps": [
        "Select 'Electronics' from the category dropdown.",
        "Observe the list of products displayed."
      ],
      "expected": "Only products categorized as 'Electronics' are shown in the list.",
      "covers": ["AC-02"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-03",
      "title": "Filter products by price range with valid minimum and maximum values",
      "level": "functional",
      "preconditions": "User is on the product catalog page with price range filters available.",
      "steps": [
        "Set minimum price to 100 and maximum price to 500.",
        "Apply the price filter and observe the results."
      ],
      "expected": "Only products with price between 100 and 500 are displayed.",
      "covers": ["AC-03"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-04",
      "title": "Search with no matching products returns 'No encontramos productos'",
      "level": "negative",
      "preconditions": "User is on the product catalog page with a search bar.",
      "steps": [
        "Enter 'xyz123' in the search bar and press enter.",
        "Wait for the results to load."
      ],
      "expected": "A message 'No encontramos productos' is displayed, indicating no matches were found.",
      "covers": ["AC-01", "AC-04"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-05",
      "title": "Filter with invalid price range (min > max) shows no results",
      "level": "edge",
      "preconditions": "User is on the product catalog page with price range filters.",
      "steps": [
        "Set minimum price to 500 and maximum price to 100.",
        "Apply the price filter and observe the results."
      ],
      "expected": "No products are displayed, and the interface should not show an error message or incorrect data.",
      "covers": ["AC-03"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-06",
      "title": "Search with empty input field returns all products or shows a placeholder",
      "level": "edge",
      "preconditions": "User is on the product catalog page with a search bar.",
      "steps": [
        "Leave the search bar empty and press enter.",
        "Observe the displayed products or search placeholder."
      ],
      "expected": "The catalog shows all products or a placeholder indicating no search term was entered.",
      "covers": ["AC-01"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-07",
      "title": "Filter by category with non-existent category returns no results",
      "level": "negative",
      "preconditions": "User is on the product catalog page with category filters.",
      "steps": [
        "Select a category that does not exist in the catalog (e.g., 'Zoo Animals').",
        "Observe the list of products displayed."
      ],
      "expected": "No products are shown, and the interface should not display an error or incorrect category list.",
      "covers": ["AC-02"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-08",
      "title": "Price range filter with zero or negative values behaves correctly",
      "level": "edge",
      "preconditions": "User is on the product catalog page with price range filters.",
      "steps": [
        "Set minimum price to 0 and maximum price to 1000.",
        "Apply the filter and observe results."
      ],
      "expected": "Products with price from 0 to 1000 are shown, including those with price 0.",
      "covers": ["AC-03"]
    }
  ]
}

test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on the address registration page.
steps: Enter a postal code with 4 digits (e.g., 1234) in the postal code field.
Submit the form to register the address.
test_cases.expected: The system rejects the input and displays an error message indicating postal code must be exactly 5 digits.

test_cases.title: Validate rejection of postal code with more than 5 digits
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on the address registration page.
steps: Enter a postal code with 6 digits (e.g., 123456) in the postal code field.
Submit the form to register the address.
test_cases.expected: The system rejects the input and displays an error message indicating postal code must be exactly 5 digits.

test_cases.title: User can designate a default address for checkout selection
test_cases.preconditions: User has at least one address registered and is on the address management page.
steps: Select an existing address from the list and click the 'Set as Default' button.
Confirm the action is completed and navigate to checkout.
test_cases.expected: The selected address appears as the default in the checkout form and is pre-filled.

test_cases.title: User cannot set more than 5 addresses as registered
test_cases.preconditions: User has already registered 5 addresses and is on the address registration page.
steps: Attempt to register a sixth address by entering valid details including a postal code.
Submit the form to register the address.
test_cases.expected: The system rejects the registration and displays a message indicating maximum of 5 addresses allowed.

test_cases.title: Validate rejection of script injection in residential address field
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on the address registration page.
steps: Enter a residential address containing script-like content (e.g., <script>alert('xss')</script>) in the residential address field.
Submit the form to register the address.
test_cases.expected: The system rejects the input and displays an error message indicating invalid characters or content.

test_cases.title: Validate rejection of special characters in residential address field
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on the address registration page.
steps: Enter a residential address with special characters (e.g., @#$%&*) in the residential address field.
Submit the form to register the address.
test_cases.expected: The system rejects the input and displays an error message indicating only valid characters are allowed.

test_cases.title: Validate that address fields are properly sanitized on submission
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on the address registration page.
steps: Enter a residential address with valid content (e.g., '123 Main St') and submit the form.
Verify the address is stored in the system without script or special characters.
test_cases.expected: The address is stored correctly and no malicious content is present in the database.

test_cases.title: Devuelve solicitud dentro del plazo de 30 días después de la entrega
test_cases.preconditions: El cliente ha recibido el producto y la fecha de entrega es registrada en el sistema.
steps: El cliente inicia una solicitud de devolución dentro de los 30 días posteriores a la fecha de entrega.
El sistema valida la fecha de entrega y el tiempo transcurrido desde ella.
test_cases.expected: La solicitud de devolución se autoriza y se procesa correctamente en el sistema.

test_cases.title: Solicitud de devolución fuera del plazo de 30 días no es autorizada
test_cases.preconditions: El cliente ha recibido el producto y ha pasado los 30 días desde la fecha de entrega.
steps: El cliente intenta iniciar una solicitud de devolución después de los 30 días desde la fecha de entrega.
El sistema verifica la fecha de entrega y el tiempo transcurrido.
test_cases.expected: La solicitud de devolución se rechaza con mensaje indicando que se ha pasado el plazo reglamentario.

test_cases.title: Solicitud de devolución por producto defectuoso requiere evidencia visual
test_cases.preconditions: El producto entregado presenta un defecto físico visible.
steps: El cliente inicia una solicitud de devolución por defecto del producto.
El sistema solicita adjuntar una foto clara del defecto.
test_cases.expected: El sistema requiere que el cliente suba al menos una foto clara del producto defectuoso como evidencia.

test_cases.title: Solicitud de devolución sin evidencia visual es rechazada
test_cases.preconditions: El producto tiene un defecto, pero el cliente no adjunta ninguna foto.
steps: El cliente inicia una solicitud de devolución por defecto del producto sin adjuntar fotos.
El sistema valida la ausencia de evidencia visual.
test_cases.expected: La solicitud se rechaza y se muestra un mensaje indicando que se requiere evidencia visual.

test_cases.title: Cliente puede elegir reembolso al método original o crédito en tienda
test_cases.preconditions: El cliente ha iniciado una solicitud de devolución válida dentro del plazo.
steps: El cliente accede a la pantalla de opciones de devolución.
El cliente selecciona 'reembolso al método de pago original' o 'crédito en tienda'.
test_cases.expected: El sistema registra la opción elegida y la guarda en el historial de devolución.

test_cases.title: Artículos de uso íntimo o higiene personal no permiten devolución
test_cases.preconditions: El producto es de uso íntimo o higiene personal (por ejemplo, jabón, toalla, protector de senos).
steps: El cliente intenta iniciar una solicitud de devolución para un producto de uso íntimo o higiene personal.
El sistema verifica el tipo de producto en la base de datos.
test_cases.expected: La solicitud se rechaza automáticamente y se muestra un mensaje indicando que estos productos no admiten devoluciones.

test_cases.title: Solicitud de devolución para producto defectuoso con foto clara se autoriza
test_cases.preconditions: El producto tiene un defecto físico visible y el cliente adjunta una foto clara.
steps: El cliente inicia una solicitud de devolución por defecto del producto.
El cliente adjunta una foto clara del defecto del producto.
test_cases.expected: La solicitud se autoriza y se procesa correctamente en el sistema.

test_cases.title: Solicitud de devolución para producto no defectuoso sin evidencia es rechazada
test_cases.preconditions: El producto está en buen estado, pero el cliente solicita devolución por razones no especificadas.
steps: El cliente inicia una solicitud de devolución sin motivo ni evidencia.
El sistema valida la ausencia de evidencia y el motivo de devolución.
test_cases.expected: La solicitud se rechaza y se muestra un mensaje indicando que se requiere evidencia o motivo válido.

test_cases.title: Reembolso al método original se procesa correctamente
test_cases.preconditions: El cliente ha iniciado una solicitud de devolución válida dentro del plazo.
steps: El cliente selecciona 'reembolso al método de pago original'.
El sistema verifica el método de pago original y procesa el reembolso.
test_cases.expected: El reembolso se realiza al método de pago original del cliente.

test_cases.title: Crédito en tienda se asigna correctamente para futuras compras
test_cases.preconditions: El cliente ha iniciado una solicitud de devolución válida dentro del plazo.
steps: El cliente selecciona 'crédito en tienda' como opción de devolución.
El sistema registra el crédito y lo asigna al cliente para futuras compras.
test_cases.expected: El cliente recibe un crédito en la tienda que puede usar en futuras compras.
